tasks.title: Announcement #32
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement on a campus radio station.
tasks.transcript: Man: Tickets for this year's spring music extravaganza at Gladstone Auditorium are now available for purchase online and at the student union box office. As always, the event will feature a lineup of your fellow students performing music from various genres, including rock, jazz, and country. This year features a special guest performer, internationally renowned cellist Ben Bernal, who graduated from our university twenty years ago. Tickets are expected to sell out quickly, so make sure to get yours today.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.A: A new process for ordering tickets
options.B: A survey of student music preferences
options.C: A change of venue for concert

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这则通知的主要话题是什么，属于主旨题，需抓住男士整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 通知中提到可以在线和在学生会售票处购票，但这只是通知中的一个细节，并非主要话题。 选项B：错误。 通知中没有提到对学生音乐偏好的调查，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 通知中明确说明活动在Gladstone Auditorium举行，并未提到场地变更，属于无关信息。 选项D：正确。 通知介绍了今年春季音乐盛会的门票信息、演出阵容和特邀嘉宾，整段话的核心话题是一场即将到来的音乐演出。

questions.stem: What is different about this year's event?

options.B: It will include a performance by a former student.
options.C: It will focus on music from various countries.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问今年的活动有什么不同之处，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士对今年活动特别之处的说明。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 通知中没有提到活动在户外举行，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 男士明确说“This year features a special guest performer, internationally renowned cellist Ben Bernal, who graduated from our university twenty years ago”，即今年的特别之处是有一位本校毕业的校友作为特邀表演嘉宾。 选项C：错误。 通知中提到演出包括摇滚、爵士和乡村等不同音乐类型，但并未说明今年聚焦于不同国家的音乐，属于过度推断。 选项D：错误。 通知中没有提到舞蹈表演，属于无中生有。
